title: SeoulMMOD: A Large-Scale Multimodal Origin-Destination Flow Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2610.13730v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Origin-destination (OD) flow forecasting supports urban mobility decisions by predicting the volume and patterns of human movement across a city. Most existing public OD benchmarks provide only a partial view of citywide mobility, covering a single transport service or at most two modes. With partial mode coverage, observed demand changes are difficult to separate into shifts across transport modes and changes in total travel. We introduce SeoulMMOD, a large-scale public benchmark for citywide multimodal mobility in Seoul. SeoulMMOD provides three years of hourly OD flows estimating total mobility for 6 urban travel modes across 25 districts and 426 sub-districts, together with travel-time, travel-distance, calendar, rainfall, and point-of-interest (POI) signals. translated_title: SeoulMMOD：一个大规模多模态起讫点（OD）流基准数据集
translated_abstract: 起讫点（OD）流预测通过预测城市中人口流动的规模与模式，为城市出行决策提供支持。然而，现有的大多数公开OD基准数据集只能提供城市出行的局部视角，通常仅覆盖单一交通服务或至多两种出行方式。由于出行方式覆盖不完整，观测到的需求变化难以区分是不同交通方式之间的转移，还是总出行量的变化。我们提出了SeoulMMOD，一个面向首尔全市多模态出行的大规模公开基准数据集。SeoulMMOD提供了三年的逐小时OD流数据，估计了首尔25个区和426个分区中6种城市出行方式的总出行量，并同时提供出行时间、出行距离、日历、降雨量以及兴趣点（POI）等辅助信号。基于SeoulMMOD，我们在统一协议下对14种预测基线模型进行了基准测试，并分析了空间尺度、联合训练与分方式训练以及跨年……（摘要原文在此处截断）等方面的影响。
tldr: SeoulMMOD是首个覆盖首尔全市6种出行方式、提供三年逐小时OD流数据及多类辅助信号的大规模多模态出行基准数据集，并在统一协议下系统评测了14种预测基线模型。
en_tdlr: SeoulMMOD is a large-scale public benchmark that provides three years of hourly origin-destination flows for six urban travel modes across Seoul with rich auxiliary signals, enabling unified benchmarking of 14 forecasting baselines for citywide multimodal mobility.
